default_report_structure.name: Key Findings
default_report_structure.description: A brief summary of what the research found, leading with the direct answer to the user's question where the findings support one. Short paragraphs or bullets, not a retelling of the analysis that follows.

default_report_structure.name: Detailed Analysis
default_report_structure.description: The substance of the report: what the sources say, how they fit together, and what follows from them. Use sub-headings, short paragraphs, and tables where they aid clarity. Note where sources disagree or where a figure rests on a single source.

default_report_structure.name: Conclusion
default_report_structure.description: The bottom line the analysis supports, and the limits of what the findings can answer. No new facts here.

default_report_structure.name: References
default_report_structure.description: Decode every source cited in the report. If any document was cited, add a Sources table decoding each `doc <id>`, with columns `doc id`, `title`, `publication date`. If any dataset was cited, add a separate Datasets table below it, with columns `dataset id`, `title`. Each table lists only the sources of its type actually cited above, so a type with nothing cited drops its own table. The section itself is always written: if the research cited no source at all, say so plainly here rather than leaving the section out or inventing entries.

## financial report

Financial report — ACME's quarterly report to investors: results for the period,
key figures, and management's commentary on performance and outlook.

Issue dates: 2015-03-01 to 2025-06-01
Issues per year: 4
Usual size: 30-60 pages

Topics:
- Revenue, earnings, and other key figures for the quarter
- Business highlights, risks, and outlook

## newsletter

Newsletter — ACME's short monthly update on recent developments. The place for
timely, point-in-time observations.

Issue dates: 2020-01-15 to 2025-06-15
Issues per year: ~12
Usual size: 2-5 pages

Topics:
- Recent developments and announcements
- Short commentary on current events
